definitions: To keep something for a particular purpose or person.
To arrange for a place, seat, or ticket to be kept for your use at a later date.
To hold back or set aside for future use or for a special reason.
To refrain from expressing or exercising (a right, opinion, etc.) immediately or fully.
examples: I'd like to reserve a table for two.
She reserved her comments until after the meeting.
The library will reserve the book for you.
They reserve the right to refuse admission.
